name: hi_statute
description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Hawaii Revised Statutes (HRS) — Hawaii state law — by citation. "707-701" is murder in the first degree; "521-44" is a landlord's security-deposit duty under the Residential Landlord-Tenant Code. Accepts natural forms: "707-701", "HRS 707-701", "§707-701". Returns the current statutory text, the official catchline, chapter context, and amendment/enactment history parsed from the Legislature's own "[L 1972, c 9, ...]" session-law bracket. Pass "year" (1999-2025) to get that year's historical archived text of the same section instead of the current one — Hawaii publishes a full year-by-year online archive. Keyless. Use for "what does HRS 707-701 say" or to check a Hawaii statute a case or lease relies on, now or as of a past year.

citation.description: Section citation, chapter-section, e.g. "707-701" (murder) or "521-44" (security deposits). Some sections carry a decimal suffix, e.g. "521-69.5".

year.description: Optional: a historical year (1999-2025) to fetch that year's archived text instead of the current one.

name: hi_search
description: Search the Hawaii Revised Statutes BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "landlord security deposit", "concealed firearm permit", "murder". Matches against the Legislature's own official section and chapter CATCHLINES across the whole Code (not full statutory prose — Hawaii does not publish a full-text search of statute body text, verified live), e.g. "landlord" surfaces sections like "Landlord's remedies for failure by tenant to pay rent" under chapter 521 (Residential Landlord-Tenant Code). Returns matching citations and catchlines; call hi_statute with a citation for the full text. Keyless.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "landlord security deposit".

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 25.
